errors.evidence: The color of the 'бензин' (petrol) slice is orange, as shown in the legend and on the top surface of the slice. Describing it as 'тъмнооранжево' (dark orange) is inaccurate; the dark brown color is part of the 3D side-effect of the chart, not the primary color of the data slice.

errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени визуално в низходящ ред по големина
errors.evidence: The description claims the slices are visually arranged in descending order of size. This is incorrect. For example, moving clockwise from the largest slice, 'бензин' (34.40%), the next slice is 'електрически' (14.40%), which is then followed by a larger slice, 'хибридни' (29.50%). The visual arrangement is not sorted.
